
| `--threshold` | number | no | `0.01` | Absolute Gini delta to count as drift (default 0.01, slightly above Aavegotchi noise floor) |

## pop org probe-access

Burner-callStatic access-control probe — map a contract's gating model in <5 min, zero gas

```text
pop org probe-access [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--abi` | string | no | - | Path to the ABI JSON file. If omitted, will try src/abi/<contract>.json by name guess; otherwise required. |
| `--address` | string | yes | - | Contract address to probe |
| `--expected-name` | string | no | - | HB#385 (task #390): expected substring in the contract's name() return value. Case-insensitive substring match — 'Compound' matches 'Compound Governor Bravo'. When set, the tool calls name() on the target before probing and warns (non-fatal) if the result doesn't match. Prevents the HB#384 class of error where an audit labeled 'Gitcoin Governor Bravo' was actually probing Uniswap's contract. The name() call always runs even without this flag — result is recorded as contractName in JSON output. |
| `--selectors` | string | no | - | Comma-separated function names or 4-byte selectors to probe. If omitted, probes ALL external/payable functions. |
| `--skip-code-check` | boolean | no | `false` | Skip the on-chain selector existence check. Use when probing behind a proxy (EIP-1967) where the runtime code does not contain the implementation selectors, or when you know the ABI matches the target. |

## pop org audit-vetoken

On-chain top-holder probe for veCRV-family VotingEscrow contracts (task #383)

```text
pop org audit-vetoken [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--chain` | number | no | `1` | Chain ID (default: Ethereum mainnet) |
| `--chunk` | number | no | `10000` | getLogs pagination chunk size in blocks. Default 10000 (most RPCs cap here). |
| `--enumerate` | boolean | no | `false` | Scan recent Deposit events to discover candidate holders. Defaults to the last 50,000 blocks (~7 days on Ethereum). Override with --from-block / --to-block / --chunk. |
| `--enumerate-transfers` | boolean | no | `false` | Task #389 (HB#456): contract-agnostic holder discovery via the underlying ERC20's Transfer(from, to) events filtered to (to == escrow). Catches dormant lockers and works for non-veCRV-family contracts (CvxLockerV2, Convex, etc.). More RPC-expensive per block than --enumerate, so use narrower --from-block windows. |
| `--escrow` | string | yes | - | VotingEscrow contract address (veCRV, veBAL, veFXS, …) |
| `--from-block` | number | no | - | Enumeration lower bound (inclusive). Default: latest - 50000. |
| `--holders` | string | no | - | Comma-separated list of candidate holder addresses to rank. Optional when --enumerate is passed. The two modes can be combined — enumerated addresses are union-ed with the explicit list. |
| `--rpc` | string | no | - | RPC URL override |
| `--to-block` | number | no | - | Enumeration upper bound (inclusive). Default: latest block. |
| `--top` | number | no | `10` | Limit output to the top N holders by current veBalance |
| `--underlying` | string | no | - | Override the underlying ERC20 token address for --enumerate-transfers. If omitted, reads VotingEscrow.token() to get it automatically. |
